# Zyago Studio

> Contemporary portrait and wedding photography studio based in Velachery, Chennai, India. Specializing in bespoke studio portraits, fine art portraiture, candid wedding photography, cinematography, family archives, maternity, and professional executive headshots.

## About Zyago Studio
Zyago Studio is an atelier-grade photography and cinematography studio founded by Venkatesh (Director of Photography) in Velachery, Chennai. The studio is dedicated to authentic, quiet elegance, architectural daylight composition, and sculpted studio lighting, serving families, couples, artists, professionals, and brands across Chennai, Tamil Nadu, and destination venues worldwide.

## Primary Services
- **Studio Portraits**: Fine art studio sittings, family portraits, kids, maternity, couples, and creative fashion portfolios.
- **Professional Headshots**: Executive LinkedIn profiles, corporate leadership portraits, and personal branding in sculpted lighting.
- **Wedding Photography & Films**: Documentary candid wedding photography, pre-wedding couple sessions, traditional rituals, and 4K cinematic films.
- **Life Events & Celebrations**: Authentic visual coverage for baby showers, engagements, anniversaries, and family milestones.
